8.fit_control: Two ends of the photographed main roof ridge. The separate roof ends, transverse shoulders and terrace form held-out comparisons.
8.limitations: Each roof can have a distinct image displacement because of building height, sensor angle and orthorectification. Unshifted absolute pixel and registered results are both reported.
